result.title: SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions
result.summary: Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per case, on par with asking the same judge for the final label (68.23%); an earlier tree compiled for a different judge scores 47.87% when executed by this judge, while a new tree compiled on this judge's answers to a 12-question initial pool already scores 64.39%. Node-level repair raises BANKING77 accuracy from 82.04% to 86.16%, an explicit exemption node cuts the false positives of a Chinese e-commerce moderation clause from 24 to 5, and a trained editor raises the development accuracy of edited trees from 64.47% to 73.35%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SemTree，将规则决策表示为语义决策树：节点是带 Yes/No/Unknown 判定的自然语言问题，由可插拔语义 judge 回答，分支结构按该 judge 实际给出的答案编译；执行路径即决策推理过程，支持节点级修复回放，纠正后的节点转为 judge 的训练标签，并用工具型 LLM 编辑器在观察执行结果后改问题与子树。
AI.relevance_reason: 节点级错误定位、回放修复与「纠正节点即标签」的监督闭环，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的贡献分配与训练监督提供可核查线索；按 judge 实际回答而非预设逻辑编译分支，也涉及推理结构是否需匹配真实执行器的问题，但论文并非视觉或多模态推理工作。
